name: BaitMe Design System
guidelines: Original BaitMe interface, familiar browsing pattern without copying Wolt/Bolt brand assets.
Only synthetic demo restaurants and prices; artwork consists of editable vector primitives.
Processing-fee amount is demonstrative and must not be charged on ordinary EEA consumer cards in Latvia.
Do not wire payment collection until payment processor, legal and payment-flow compliance is approved.
Design UI states: empty cart, quantity edits, fees explained, disabled payment state.
